name: VisionArena
description: VisionArena is a dataset of 230K real-world conversations between users and vision-language models (VLMs), capturing authentic user-VLM interactions across 138 languages. It includes subsets for single and multi-turn conversations, model comparison battles with user preference votes, and an automatic benchmark approximating live model rankings, focusing on tasks like captioning, humor, spatial reasoning, and planning.
reputation: A newly introduced large-scale vision-language arena benchmark that is gaining attention for real-world VLM evaluation, but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes three subsets: VisionArena-Chat, VisionArena-Battle, and VisionArena-Bench; highlights challenges in style-dependent tasks and spatial reasoning.
